/contact.description: Tell me about your restaurant or hotel and where it's stuck. Book a free discovery call - engagements available on-site and remote, nationwide.
/contact.body:
Whether you’re opening, recovering, or scaling - tell me what you’re working through. I read every message and respond within one business day.

Every inquiry goes directly to me. No intake coordinators, no discovery calls with junior staff. You tell me what you need - I’ll tell you honestly whether I can help.

What Happens After You Send

  1. I Read It. Every message goes directly to me - no intake team, no triage. I read it the same day.
  2. Honest Reply. Within one business day you get a direct response on whether I can help, and what that looks like.
  3. We Decide Together. If there’s a fit, we do a short call to confirm scope and get started. No pressure, no pitch deck.

What to include in your message

What’s the challenge? What have you already tried? What does success look like in 90 days? Share the name of your restaurant or hotel if you can, and whether you need F&B Operations Consulting, Pre-Opening Support, Operations Recovery, or Speaking or Training.

How we can work together

  • F&B Operations Consulting: Monthly Retainer · On-Site + Remote. Starting at $7,000 /month
  • Pre-Opening Consulting: Fixed-Scope Project · Construction to Opening Night. From $35,000 /project
  • Operations Recovery: Diagnostic + 90-Day Plan · Underperforming Assets. From $12,000 /project
  • Speaking & Team Training: Keynotes, Workshops & Leadership Development. $3,500 /session

Email info@leandermena.com. Based in Miami, Florida, working with restaurants and hotels across the U.S., on-site and remote. I respond within one business day. No sales pitch - just a straight answer.

/services.title: F&B Operations & Pre-Opening Consulting Services | Leander Mena
/services.description: Four ways to work with an F&B operations consultant: pre-opening builds, ongoing consulting, turnarounds, and hybrid on-site + remote support across the U.S.
/services.body:
Executive-level F&B leadership for restaurants and hotels anywhere in the U.S., without the full-time executive cost. Every engagement is scoped to the specific gaps and goals of your operation.

Leander Mena provides F&B operations consulting for restaurants and hotels nationwide. With 20 years running operations across independent concepts, hotel F&B programs, and high-volume banquet venues in Miami's most competitive market, you get executive-level leadership and a proven operating playbook, without the full-time executive headcount.

F&B Operations Consulting

Monthly Retainer · On-Site + Remote

Senior operational leadership on a consulting basis: typically 2-4 days per week on-site, remainder remote. I step in as your interim Director of Operations or F&B Director, bringing 20 years of proven systems to independent restaurants, hotel F&B programs, and multi-unit groups nationwide.

Starting at $7,000 / month · 3-month minimum · $22,000/mo for full multi-unit oversight

What is included

  • On-site presence 2-4 days per week
  • Weekly P&L review and action planning
  • SOP development and implementation
  • Team training and development programs
  • Vendor negotiation and cost optimization
  • Monthly board reporting and analytics

Deliverables

  • Custom operations manual
  • Training completion certificates
  • Cost reduction analysis report
  • 30-60-90 day progress reviews
  • Handover documentation

Ideal for

  • Independent restaurants hitting growth plateaus
  • Multi-concept groups experiencing operational drift
  • Hotel management companies in transition
  • Investor groups who acquired hospitality assets

Pre-Opening Consulting

Fixed-Scope Project · Construction to Opening Night

End-to-end pre-opening management for new restaurant and hotel F&B concepts anywhere in the U.S. From the first construction walkthrough to training your opening team and executing a flawless launch, delivered as a structured fixed-scope engagement.

From $35,000 fixed-scope project · typically 3-4 months · complex hotel F&B up to $75,000

What is included

  • 120-day pre-opening roadmap creation
  • Team recruitment and hiring support
  • Complete SOP and training manual development
  • Vendor selection and contract negotiation
  • Menu development and costing analysis
  • Soft opening and grand opening execution

Deliverables

  • Complete operations manual
  • Fully trained opening team
  • Vendor contracts and price sheets
  • Finalized menu with costed recipes
  • Opening night run-of-show
  • 30-day post-opening support

Ideal for

  • First-time restaurant owners
  • Hotel developments adding F&B concepts
  • Multi-unit expansions
  • Concept rebranding and relaunches

Operations Recovery

Diagnostic + 90-Day Plan · Underperforming Assets

Diagnostic-intensive engagement for restaurants and hotels missing their targets. Starts with a structured on-site diagnostic, then moves into a clear 90-day turnaround plan with weekly accountability, available nationwide.

From $12,000 diagnostic + 90-day plan · multi-unit recovery engagements quoted separately

What is included

  • Full operations diagnostic (5-7 days on-site)
  • P&L deep-dive and variance analysis
  • Labor model optimization
  • Service standard reset and retraining
  • Cost structure audit and reduction plan
  • Revenue enhancement opportunities

Deliverables

  • Diagnostic report with findings
  • 90-day turnaround action plan
  • Weekly progress tracking dashboard
  • Restructured labor model
  • Monthly P&L improvement reports
  • Sustainability playbook

Ideal for

  • Properties missing revenue targets
  • New acquisitions needing stabilization
  • Concepts experiencing quality drift
  • Leadership transition periods

Speaking & Team Training

Keynotes, Workshops & Leadership Development

High-impact speaking engagements and customized training programs for hospitality teams, industry conferences, and corporate leadership retreats.

$3,500 per session · travel additional

What is included

  • Customized keynote or workshop content
  • Pre-event consultation and planning
  • Interactive training materials
  • Post-event resource package
  • Optional follow-up coaching sessions
  • Media and PR support available

Deliverables

  • Custom presentation deck
  • Participant workbook
  • Recording (if permitted)
  • Follow-up action items
  • Impact measurement report

Ideal for

  • Hospitality industry conferences
  • Corporate leadership retreats
  • Hotel group annual meetings
  • Restaurant group team development days
